verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's own API reference documents each parameter with concrete examples (e.g. ueiSAM=RV56IG5JM6G9, legalBusinessName=ALLTEL) and full request URLs. With an API key, these examples can be run as GET calls in a browser. The docs page also carries a downloadable OpenAPI spec. However, nothing shows an interactive in-page console. Running calls relies on the user's browser or Postman, and the 404 probes at common OpenAPI paths only show the spec isn't at well-known locations. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console in the reference, executable examples inside the docs themselves, independent or hands-on corroboration.
